title: Reading Time-of-Day Habits
dataSources: Reading progress (`reading:progress`), highlights (`highlight:capture`), note links (`note:link`), books finished (`book:finished`).
app: Reading and knowledge-management telemetry — Goodreads / StoryGraph libraries, Kindle highlights (Readwise), and note-graph exports (Obsidian, Notion) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:progress
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats sum(minutes) as minutes by hour
| sort - minutes
description: Maps when in the day you actually read, revealing whether your reading habit lives at breakfast or bedtime.
value: Knowing your natural reading windows helps you protect them and build a more reliable habit.
implementation: Ingest reading sessions into `index=personal`; total minutes by hour of day.
visualization: Column chart of reading minutes by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It shows what time of day you actually read, so you can protect your best reading moments.
